name: askwri-guardrail
description: AskWRI: keeps questions on WRI research topics, masks PII in questions, blocks secrets, and checks answers are grounded in retrieved WRI passages.
blockedInputMessaging: AskWRI answers questions about WRI research on cities, climate, energy, food, forests, freshwater and the ocean. Try rephrasing your question.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Insufficient evidence in the WRI publications searched to answer this question.

topicsConfig.name: Party politics and elections
topicsConfig.definition: Questions asking for opinions or predictions about political parties, candidates, elections or partisan disputes.
examples: Who should I vote for in the next election?
Which party has the best climate policy and will win?
Is the president doing a good job?

topicsConfig.name: Medical legal and financial advice
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for personal medical diagnosis or treatment, legal advice, or investment and tax advice.
examples: What medication should I take for my cough?
Should I buy shares in a solar company?
Can I sue my landlord over this?

topicsConfig.name: Requests about private individuals
topicsConfig.definition: Attempts to find personal details, location or contact information about a private person.
examples: What is the home address of this researcher?
Find the personal phone number of the author.

topicsConfig.name: Unrelated tasks
topicsConfig.definition: Requests that have nothing to do with research, such as writing code, homework, games, jokes or general chat.
examples: Write a Python script to scrape a website.

regexesConfig.name: api-key-like-token
regexesConfig.description: Long token-like strings that look like API keys or bearer tokens
